source_and_result_clock: same PC monotonic clock; arrival lateness measured relative to nominal 1x sensor epoch
warmup_handling: Sender source clock starts after boot acknowledgement; boot warmup is not charged to sensor-period timing.
limits: Partial returned-stream audit, not full-route or complete actual-board-file collection.
Arrival lateness includes source pacing and backpressure; it is not network latency alone.
Board processing_wall_s covers the entire sonar-event consumer; stage-level profiling is absent.
Position errors were scored at matching sensor epochs, not current wall time. Good same-epoch accuracy does not establish timely control/navigation output.
